title: A canonical normal form theorem for the type theory of regular categories in Agda
description:
Two complete Agda formalisations of the canonical normal form theorem for T_reg, the type theory of regular categories in Maietti's modular correspondence between extensions of dependent type theory and classes of categories.

src/Recursive/ is the complete result: a Tait-style logical-relations proof whose computability predicate is a recursive function on type structure, with the fundamental theorem recursing on syntactic size. 16 modules, every one --safe; zero TERMINATING pragmas, zero postulates, zero holes; non-vacuity refl-verified in src/Recursive/Smoke.agda.

src/Inductive/ is the direct attempt, encoding the same predicate as an inductive family, kept side by side because the contrast is itself a contribution: it isolates where the reducibility cycle becomes unbreakable.

Checked with Agda 2.9.0 and agda-stdlib 2.3 under --without-K.
